plain_description.what: Planned to re-judge all 9,144 arena matches with the adopted judge recipe plus a short data-only description card of each question's cell, about 18,300 judge calls, and compare it to the previous arena.
plain_description.why: It would have tested whether the cell-description card improves the judge at full arena scale.
plain_description.information: A gain would have supported putting cell descriptions into the judge's prompt; no gain would have shown they are not worth it. Result: withdrawn and never run, so there are no numbers. The card's earlier gain was a single positive among twelve tests and did not replicate with a second judge. A cheaper fix (breaking ties with repeated judgments) did the same job better, and the run was 4.5 times over the approval threshold.
